[Apple](https://variety.com/t/apple/) booked a record haul for the December 2025 quarter thanks to a spike in iPhone sales, while its services business continued to boom, reaching $30 billion in revenue for the first time.

Overall, Apple reported revenue of $143.8 billion (up 16%) for the three months ended Dec. 27, which is its first quarter of fiscal 2026.
The tech giant’s huge quarter was driven by a 23% bump in iPhone sales, to $85.27 billion.
Apple’s services segment also posted record quarterly revenue, coming in at $30.0 billion, up 14% year over year (roughly in line with analyst projections).
